scope: PySTreeD Accuracy only: constant feature identity cost, no task constraints, binary splits. Other PySTreeD tasks are not claimed safe.
scientific_note: A descendant-specific split quotient was integrated into the pinned PySTreeD Accuracy solver. Original and patched binaries proved identical score, depth and node-count optima on four native datasets and four deterministic descendant-equivalence variants. The patch eliminated 59586 equivalent feature branches, reduced augmented subtree calls by 30.3% and branch expansions by 29.8%, and achieved 1.11x median reported runtime speedup. Native tasks preserved exact optima but showed up to 20.2% runtime overhead from the deliberately simple linear partition archive, motivating a hashed implementation and a fresh native holdout.
